strengths.I008-v2: Staggered one-fifth-of-gap daily trading with a drift-inclusive weekly cap makes the turnover and frequency gates structural, and stress-day covariance plus a stock-bond-correlation budget tilt is a sensible crisis-aware design.
strengths.I002-v2: Absorption-ratio-weighted sign-preserving stress covariance inside ERC is a genuinely new mechanism with a regime argument for why hedges shift (Treasuries in flight-to-quality, gold/commodities in 2022), and it comes with an explicit worst-case drawdown calculation (about 17.8%).

verdicts.reason: I008's CPPI floor m=clip(6*(1-0.8*HWM/NAV)) reaches zero exposure only at exactly 20% drawdown, leaving no slippage reserve, whereas I002 tapers to zero at 18% from the all-time peak and gives an explicit worst-case bound.

strengths.I004-v2: Sizes a cash reserve so one stress-tail 20-day loss across all clusters (N-1 style) stays under 16%, with a derived exposure floor and asymmetric shed/restore ramps, which is a clear and principled drawdown argument.
strengths.I002-v2: Regime-aware stress-mixture ERC with a taper measured from the all-time NAV peak, a worst-case walk-through (about 17.8% drawdown), and Mon/Wed/Fri sessions with per-session caps that let the exposure cut take priority.

verdicts.reason: I004 measures drawdown from a 756-day rolling peak and admits chained episodes can exceed 16% all-time (with hand-set loss priors and one major critique still open), while I002 uses the all-time peak so the 20% bound is actually what is controlled.

strengths.I003-v2: Very simple and transparent: equal standalone risk per cluster by rule, a Grossman-Zhou style cushion droop, and a daily cap including drift that makes the constraints part of the control law, with few parameters and low implementation risk.
strengths.I002-v2: Adds a new mechanism (absorption-driven blend toward a sign-preserving one-factor stress prior) with literature support, a vol cap plus all-time-peak taper, and a fully specified scheduler that meets the 3-day and 20% constraints.

verdicts.reason: I003 is essentially inverse-vol cluster parity with a textbook CPPI droop and a decaying peak that weakens the all-time drawdown bound, while I002 offers a new stress-aware covariance mechanism with a stated reason it should work and no comparable weakness on the peak definition.
